# Angelo Mele
<p class="hero-kicker">Economist & Data Scientist</p>
<p class="hero-role">Applied econometrics, causal inference, pricing, and network models</p>

I use econometrics, machine learning, and network models to understand behavior and improve economic decisions. I am an Economist in Wayfair’s Pricing Algorithms team and previously served as an Associate Professor at Johns Hopkins Carey Business School.

My research studies social interactions, scalable estimation of network models, and counterfactual analysis of those models.

::: {.actions}

:::

## Areas of expertise

::: {.expertise-grid}
::: {.expertise-card}
### Causal inference and experimentation

I use applied econometrics and experimental methods to study behavior and to evaluate interventions, including work on social interactions and treatment environments shaped by networks.
:::

::: {.expertise-card}
### Pricing and economic decision-making

At Wayfair I work on pricing algorithms, using causal inference, machine learning, and applied econometrics to support pricing decisions.
:::

::: {.expertise-card}
### Networks and computational social science

A large part of my research develops structural and statistical models of network formation, with applications to schools, firms, professional contacts, and software dependencies.
:::
:::

## Featured software and projects

::: {.project-cards}
::: {.project-card}
### Neural estimation of network models

A working paper on using neural networks to estimate exponential random graph models. The project is in development; remaining work includes simulations and theoretical points.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.01810) · [Project details](projects.qmd#neural-estimation-of-network-models)
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Systemic risk in software networks

A strategic model of software dependency networks and how vulnerabilities can propagate through those dependencies. Related to the published ACM EC paper on software dependency networks.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.13375) · [Project details](projects.qmd#systemic-risk-in-software-dependency-networks)
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Scalable network estimation

Package contributions for large-network estimation, including spectral methods and hierarchical ERGMs. Authorship is shared; I am not the sole author or current maintainer of every package.

[Project details](projects.qmd#scalable-network-estimation-software)
:::
:::
